chunks: And Isma'il ibn Jabir narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Do not expose yourselves to obligations, but if they become binding upon you, then be patient with them.

key_terms.الْحُقُوقِ: rights, claims, or obligations due upon a person
key_terms.تَتَعَرَّضُوا: to put yourselves forward for or expose yourselves to something
key_terms.لَزِمَتْكُمْ: became binding or obligatory upon you

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about taking on obligations and rights?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint in taking on claims, obligations, or dues that may burden a person. If such duties do become binding, it instructs one to endure them with patience and steadfastness.
